F_FULL_BANK_DIAGNOSTIC.purpose: oracle/headroom, counterfactual policy matrix, and routing diagnostics

P_PORTFOLIO_ATTRIBUTION.claim_role: optional powered secondary or future separate claim
P_PORTFOLIO_ATTRIBUTION.independent_unit: portfolio construction / random-bank draw, subject to dependence from shared families and policies
P_PORTFOLIO_ATTRIBUTION.purpose: compare A0-maximin with competence-matched non-geometric portfolios

U_UTILITY_ONLY.endpoint: Delta_utility = mean over families and rollouts of correctness(router-selected policy) minus correctness(frozen champion)
U_UTILITY_ONLY.same_policy_rule: when router and champion select the exact same frozen policy, one generation with the frozen block seed is shared by both logical roles and contributes paired difference zero; distinct policies use independent frozen seeds

paper_strategies.A: confirm realized utility; retain portfolio geometry as development evidence
paper_strategies.B: confirm realized utility and separately power portfolio attribution

claim_precedence.selection_priority: recommend A unless a subspace/bank-level design is independently calibrated and compute-justified; G and C-OOS cannot be revived

final_router_training_contract.option_a: refitting the already-frozen architecture/hyperparameters on a separately declared new-development split would create a new candidate system and require a new untouched confirmation split
final_router_training_contract.option_b: reopening architecture/hyperparameter selection is a new development stage and is outside Q3.3
final_router_training_contract.qualification_use: instrument qualification only; no router, bank, champion, parser, or threshold adaptation

generated_instrument_requirements.family_definition: one independently structured program; different inputs to the same source program are not independent families
model_free_generator: no filesystem, network, imports, nondeterminism, or ambient state
exact sandboxed reference execution with timeout
loops, branching, nested control flow, containers, and bounded recursion if enabled
near-duplicate detection at token, AST, and behavioral-signature levels
independent dual reference verification and property-based tests

primary_inference_addendum.confidence_interval: studentized family-level paired mean interval, retained only if prespecified calibration and coverage criteria pass

future_candidate_guards_for_prelock.utility: positive Delta_utility under the calibrated primary test and interval
future_candidate_guards_for_prelock.pathology: no prospectively defined concentrated catastrophic failure mode
future_candidate_guards_for_prelock.practical_effect: report whether the lower interval bound exceeds 0 and whether the point estimate reaches +0.03; do not conflate statistical and practical criteria

report_separately: one-call deployment tokens/latency and routing concentration

reviewer_red_team: one deterministic A0 bank versus a random-bank population
whether Q3 belongs in the current Q1/Q2 paper or remains an extension
